items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I think a singer by the name of, I think her last name was Knight, but that was sort of a novelty tune.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

thing. I tried to include a few songs in my repertoire. They don't appear to be funny but they're subtly humorous. Even I used the 'Surprise Party,' you know. Of course Pearl Bailey made that popular. But it's funny And I did "Legalize My Name" from"St. Louis Woman." you know, /And for awhile there I was doing two songs that Gracie Fields was made famous, "I Never Cried So Much In All My Life" and the other one was, "Let Him Go, Let Him Tarry", you know. In fact, "Let Him Go, Let Him Tarry" became a pop tune…
At the Village Vanguard did you have a regular accompanist there?
